# Pixel Switchboard

A simple offline browser app with 8 labelled switches and matching lamps. Each switch toggles its lamp, and there are All on / All off buttons plus a live counter of lamps that are on.

## Features

- 8 switches labelled A–H, each with a lamp.
- Toggle individual switches on/off.
- All on and All off buttons.
- Counter showing how many lamps are on.
- Fully keyboard accessible with visible focus states.
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide.
- No external dependencies or network requests.

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server required.

## Files

- `index.html` – main page structure
- `styles.css` – styling and responsive layout
- `script.js` – switch logic and counter

## Accessibility

- Buttons are focusable and have `aria-pressed` states.
- Counter uses `aria-live="polite"` for screen reader announcements.
- Visible focus outlines on all interactive elements.
